title: 第21章 干渴第22章 切割
content_zh:
记不清冬眠后第几次离体外出。
当结束望月滑回洞窟，疲惫睁开眼想蠕动几下，赫然发现洞窟内弥漫浓浓雾气。
“……”
发生了什么？
甚至下意识地确认自己是否真的回到了躯体，吐了吐信子捕捉气味，茫然环顾四周，好端端的怎会凭空冒出这么多雾？
很好，又有事情可供忧虑，忧虑越多越有利于生长。
有雾就有雾吧，反正没危险。
忽然感到喉间干渴，此刻理应因无法抵御严寒而深陷冬眠，然而，黑蛇的存在本身就是一个异数。
决定出去找水喝。
吞吐蛇信子，身躯缓慢蠕动起来，头部先穿过狭窄通道往外滑。
崖下雪地，结满白霜的洞口出现硕大蛇头。
低温让黑蛇的思绪与血液一同变得粘稠，做什么都有点慢，近视眼只能看到一片模糊的颜色。
倚赖热感应，在昏暗酷寒中依据万物的温差，将世界还原为由明暗色块构成的、不断修正的画面。
吞吐几下信子，感觉信子都变凉了。
附近好像没有水源。
只能去谷底看看，这口渴的滋味实在难以忍受。
慢悠悠的，两丈多长的沉重身躯彻底脱离洞窟，如巨犁在雪地破开深痕，身躯左右摆动，偶尔碾过积雪引起坍塌，被埋在白雪里往山下滑。
今天不算冷，山阴的雪酥松，阳坡的雪有点湿软，须以不同方式移动。
乌鸦呱噪点破寂静，冬季回音格外明显。
黑蛇留下长长弯曲痕迹抵达谷底。

吐信子搜索，缓缓滑行至冰面，紧贴冰层，感应捕捉着冰带来的微弱震动与回响。
分叉信子高频吞吐，于空气中剥离出湿润的水汽。
在白色世界寻找流水的蛛丝马迹，然后调转方向，沉默而执着的向着流水接近。
又过了一会儿。
黑蛇停在溪流边一个新掘的土坑旁。
冻土之下的新鲜黑泥仍在散发缕缕水汽，与之混杂的，还有一股陌生野兽气息。
某些野兽能透过积雪和泥土找到水源，然后掘土获取泉水。
黑蛇扫视附近并未发现大型热源，这才将头探入坑底，信子如探针轻点泉水，分析判断确认无恙后，便安心低头啜饮。
此地危机四伏，不宜久留，饮水后准备返回洞窟。
真是怕什么来什么。
猛地察觉到地面传来异常震动，土坡后一个庞大热源悍然现身！
同时寒风变向，随之而来的是一股浑浊气浪，带来野兽怪异味道，松脂味，泥土味，以及其它难以名状的气息，各种浓烈气味混合交织在一起。
对方是一头中等体型野猪，不知从哪里流窜而来，黑蛇注意到野猪粗壮脖颈有几道皮开肉绽的抓痕。
对方体型太大无法吞咽，应当避免无意义的消耗与冲突。
然而野猪却不这么想……
深冬冰雪覆盖大地，食物短缺，野猪处于饥饿状态时会变得更具攻击性。
老虎等走兽会谨慎评估蛇毒的致命风险，而野猪脑袋一根筋，前者权衡生死，后者饿极了全然不顾后果。
于是，黑蛇看着野猪喷着热气发起冲撞。
出乎意料，当霸主久了，没想到居然有走兽不懂权衡。
content_en:
I can’t remember how many times I went outside after hibernating.
When he finished looking at the moon and slid back into the cave, he opened his eyes tiredly and wanted to squirm a few times, and suddenly found that the cave was filled with thick fog.
"……"
what happened?
He even subconsciously confirmed whether he had really returned to his body, spit out the scent to catch the smell, and looked around blankly. How could he have so much fog appearing out of thin air?
Great, there are things to worry about. The more worries, the better for growth.
If it's foggy, it's foggy. It's not dangerous anyway.
Suddenly I felt thirsty in my throat. At this moment, I should have fallen into hibernation due to my inability to withstand the severe cold. However, the existence of the black snake itself was an anomaly.
Decided to go out to find water.
Swallowing the snake letter, the body slowly began to squirm, and the head first slid out through the narrow passage.
In the snow under the cliff, a huge snake head appeared at the entrance of the cave covered with frost.
The low temperature made Black Snake's thoughts and blood become viscous. Everything he did was a bit slow, and his short-sighted eyes could only see a blur of color.
Relying on thermal induction, according to the temperature difference of all things in the dark and cold, the world is restored into a constantly modified picture composed of light and dark color blocks.
After swallowing the letter a few times, I felt that the letter had become cold.
There seems to be no water source nearby.
I can only go to the bottom of the valley to have a look. The thirst is really unbearable.
Slowly, the two-foot-long heavy body completely left the cave, like a giant plow making deep marks in the snow. The body swayed left and right, occasionally running over the snow and causing a collapse, and it was buried in the white snow and slid down the mountain.
It's not too cold today. The snow on the mountainside is crisp and pine, while the snow on the sunny slope is a bit soft and needs to be moved in different ways.
The noise of crows breaks the silence, and the echo is particularly clear in winter.
The black snake leaves a long curved trail to reach the bottom of the valley.
Tu Xinzi searched, slowly gliding to the ice surface, clinging to the ice layer, sensing and capturing the weak vibrations and echoes brought by the ice.
The bifurcated letters are pumped out at high frequency, stripping out moist water vapor in the air.
Look for clues of flowing water in the white world, then change direction and approach the flowing water silently and persistently.
After a while.
The black snake stopped at a newly dug earthen hole by the stream.
The fresh black mud under the frozen soil is still emitting wisps of water vapor, and mixed with it is the smell of strange beasts.
Certain beasts can find water through snow and mud, and then dig into the earth to obtain spring water.
Black Snake scanned the area and found no large heat source. Then he put his head into the bottom of the pit and tapped the spring water like a probe. After analyzing and judging that it was fine, he lowered his head and sipped with peace of mind.
This place is full of dangers and it is not advisable to stay for a long time. After drinking water, prepare to return to the cave.
I am really afraid of what will happen.
Suddenly I noticed an abnormal vibration coming from the ground, and a huge heat source suddenly appeared behind the slope!
At the same time, the cold wind changed direction, followed by a wave of turbid air, which brought the strange smell of wild animals, the smell of rosin, the smell of earth, and other indescribable smells. Various strong smells were mixed and intertwined.
The opponent was a medium-sized wild boar, which came from nowhere. Black Snake noticed that there were several scratches on the wild boar's thick neck.
The opponent is too big to swallow, so meaningless consumption and conflict should be avoided.
However, the wild boar doesn't think so...
In late winter, when ice and snow cover the ground and food is scarce, wild boars become more aggressive when they are hungry.
Tigers and other animals carefully evaluate the fatal risk of snake venom, while wild boars are stubborn. The former weighs life and death, while the latter is extremely hungry and ignores the consequences.
So, the black snake watched the wild boar charge with its hot breath.
Unexpectedly, after being the overlord for a long time, I didn’t expect that there are animals that don’t know how to weigh.
